authorial_core.interpreted_intent: The actual prior human topic resolves the current pronoun to school-life poses, clothing and visible appearance. Authorial choice: one woman, fictional age 22, in a university classroom, tightening a shoe lace before departure. A seated lace-tying pause was chosen over a windowsill reading pause because clothing, articulated pose, load-bearing support and hand-object contact form one readable everyday event. The reference supplies visible face/hair only and establishes no real age, identity, biography or personality. At sensual 1 the small glance and tactile everyday dress support her presence; fetish 0 and surreal 0 add no treatment. Creativity 1 permits restrained post-core refinements. The intended experience is an unforced interruption within a real academic room. Pose, age, exact clothes, props and camera are agent-owned choices, not requester locks. A frontal three-quarter full seated view should expose both hands on two lace ends, their relation to the shoe tongue, right ankle on left thigh, pelvis on chair and left shoe on floor together.

authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: An observational school-life photograph of the central woman in an everyday school-life moment. She is a fictional 22-year-old university student, paused in a quiet classroom just before leaving. The supplied portrait guides her visible face and hair: a dark chin-length bob with a softly curved edge, separated wispy fringe, dark eyes beneath straight brows, a soft oval face, and small naturally shaped lips. Her presence feels particular and unforced, with a brief attentive glance toward the photographer while her hands finish their task. She sits sideways on a wooden classroom chair in the aisle beside her desk. Her pelvis rests securely on the chair seat, her left knee points forward, and her left shoe is planted flat on the floor. Her right leg is externally rotated with her right ankle resting across her left thigh just above the knee; the right shoe projects toward the open aisle. Leaning forward from her hips, she holds one lace end in each hand and draws the two ends taut above the tongue of that right shoe. The fingers, two lace ends, shoe tongue, ankle-on-thigh support and grounded left foot read together in the same view. The chair and desk leave open space for her elbows and lifted knee. She wears a pale blue cotton blouse with sleeves casually rolled to her forearms, a cream cable-knit vest, a charcoal pleated skirt falling to the knee, ivory ribbed socks and worn brown leather Oxford shoes. The raised knee organizes the skirt's natural folds, while the rolled cuffs free her wrists for the small task. An open canvas shoulder bag and a closed lecture notebook sit together on the adjacent desktop, ready for her to pick up. Rows of empty desks, a chalkboard with faint erased marks, and tall classroom windows make the academic setting visible. Photograph from a frontal three-quarter position at seated chest height, far enough back to include her complete seated figure, chair support and both shoes. Keep her face and the working hands on the raised shoe large enough to read, with a little aisle floor around the grounded foot. Soft late-afternoon window light shapes her face, the blouse creases and knit texture; the brown wood and pale blue fabric carry the quiet color rhythm. A natural 40 mm perspective and moderate depth of field connect her face, the shoe and the neighboring bag within one inhabited room.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.
